For x ∈ B_j and r < r_j/2 − |x − x_j|, B_r(x) ⊆ B_j, so ν_j = μ on B_r(x) and the quotients agree; thus the claim holds for μ-a.e. x ∈ B_j, and by countable union for μ-a.e. x ∈ W.
